incident: A burst-queued follow-up was promoted, given the full capture-time UX (:eyes: reaction + progress card, checklist-posted 04:36:19Z) by turn answer running inside the PREVIOUS ask's one-shot fresh-visible-session child workspace, and the burst-dequeued handoff line was printed to that child's stdout as it ended. The continuous-drain loop session never saw it, so the ask was never dispatched. turn dispatch --sweep returns early for any ask with no activeDispatch (dispatchSweep.ts), so nothing terminalised the card: it sat mid-checklist at 'Work out how to answer' in a public channel for ~6 hours, and the message queued behind it (1788148044.130839) is stranded permanently because only a terminal event drains a burst queue.
